name_es: Ibn Ḥazm (ʿAlī ibn Aḥmad ibn Saʿīd, Abū Muḥammad al-Ẓāhirī, de Córdoba)
name_en: Ibn Hazm (ʿAli ibn Ahmad ibn Said, Abu Muhammad al-Zahiri)
name_orig: ابن حزم (علي بن أحمد بن سعيد، أبو محمد الظاهري)
role_place: Andalusian (Cordoba-born) Zahiri jurist, theologian and heresiographer
why_relevant: Records a heretic's accusation of marriage slander (P03); states Aisha's age at the Hijra (P04); reports and answers the "special privilege" defence and gives the marriage at six (P05).
fame: Very well known: author of al-Fisal and al-Muhalla; major Zahiri jurist and heresiographer.

name_es: Ibn Kaṯīr (Ismāʿīl ibn ʿUmar al-Qurašī, Abū l-Fidāʾ)
name_en: Ibn Kathir (Ismail ibn Umar, Abu l-Fida)
name_orig: ابن كثير (إسماعيل بن عمر القرشي، أبو الفداء)
born: c. 700 AH (c. 1301 CE): standard date, not in the OpenITI metadata (NOTGIVEN); not verified by me
why_relevant: P07: says the marriage at six and consummation at nine is undisputed among people, while doubting the chronology.

born: 773 AH (1372 CE): standard date, not in the OpenITI metadata; not verified by me
died: 852 AH (1449 CE): standard date, not verified by me
role_place: Cairo-based hadith scholar and Shafi'i jurist
why_relevant: P06: reports Ibn Shubruma's legal objection about minor virgins and the "special privilege" defence of the marriage at six (subject of the claim ambiguous).
fame: Very well known (Fath al-Bari, commentary on al-Bukhari).

name_es: ʿAbd al-Masīḥ ibn Isḥāq al-Kindī (atribuido; autor no identificado en OpenITI)
role_place: Christian correspondent who replies to al-Hashimi; place not stated in my sources. OpenITI header places the exchange in the time of al-Ma'mun (247 AH / 861 CE; editor's claim, not verified).
why_relevant: P01 and P02: Christian polemic that names Aisha among Muhammad's wives and calls her the only virgin and youngest. Not a Muslim source; outside the core brief, flagged for the Arabic-Christian team.
fame: Known from the "Apology of al-Kindi" literature (Van Koningsveld 2004, cited in the OpenITI header, not read by me).
community: Christian (church not stated in the text)
